The '''Grissmaths''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="EGTAS" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meridian]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Grissmaths formed the [[Grissmath Dynasty]],<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> and their vicious nature led them to transport a number of political [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], seeding the world with [[Droch/Legends|droch]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] in an effort to kill them off. The Grissmaths eventually self-destructed,<ref name="CSWE" /> having been wiped out by the [[Death Seed]] plague<ref name="TPOT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020905twilight|text=The Planet of Twilight}}</ref> and their homeworld left as a charred radioactive waste.<ref name="PoT" />
